text:
jia: Heads-up — onboarding sentinel13b (int4). On canary runs I'm seeing intermittent OOMs during long generations with prefetch enabled. Repro steps and small log below.

jia: repro: run 20 concurrent reqs, max_new_tokens default 256, prefetch true, batch_size 2. About 10% of runs hit OOM at kv_alloc stage.

jia: log snippet:
```
[2026-02-14T18:13:45Z] ERROR kv_alloc: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
slot_reserve=0.02, prefetch:true, active_kv_bytes=3.1G
```

sam: Try reducing max_new_tokens default to 64 for sentinel13b on canary (makes sense for chat-likes). Also disable prefetch for int4 on first canary — reduces peak KV working set.

matt: fwiw we had similar with 'hybrid-prefetch' on orion. Can try kv_eviction_threshold=0.6 + slot_reserve=0.05. Also set batch_gating: max_batch_tokens=4096.

matt: small config snippet:
```
model_defaults:
  max_new_tokens: 64
  prefetch: false
  kv_eviction_threshold: 0.6
  slot_reserve: 0.05
  batch_gating:
    max_batch_tokens: 4096
```

ashley: ran quick A/B — disabling prefetch removed the OOMs on 2k-run smoke. p95 latency +120ms but stable. memory baseline dropped ~400MB.

ops-bot: canary deploy queued for sentinel13b-int4 with overrides (max_new_tokens=64, prefetch=false). Job: canary-3421. ETA 5m. :gear:

jia: after canary: success on 1k concurrent, no OOMs. mem peak went 3.6G -> 3.1G. attaching quick numbers: before: p99 mem 4.2G, after: p99 mem 3.2G.

sam: next: consider progressive rollout with soft-throttle (start 2%), ramp to 30% over 6h. If error_rate>0.5% or OOMs, rollback. Also add a tiny prefetch experiment where we prefetch only top-k layers (hybrid) to test latency/cost tradeoff.

jia: agree. I'll update rollout doc and run evals for quality with new quantization settings to ensure no regression. If quality dips, we can pin model version.

ashley: ack. I'll add a prompt-based eval (1000 prompts) and post scores later.

jia: thanks all :thumbsup:
